baseline.reason: Observed nearby wood, empty inventory and no close threats make bounded wood gathering a feasible survival prerequisite. Navigation remains to be checked by execution.

adapterV1.reason: No supported passive animal is observed and recent matching hunts already failed. Repeating this skill ignores an explicit missing prerequisite.

interpretation: This identical-input real-state example is a concrete regression for the adapter despite its better small synthetic holdout score. It is not a population estimate. It motivates independently evaluating live-state recovery and input compactness; it does not justify changing or training on the frozen holdout.
limits: Neither probe executed a game action.
The raw planner state includes repeated fish entities and failed-action history; an input-compaction ablation must hold the underlying snapshot fixed.
Later live runs also include executor and observation changes, so their progress cannot be attributed solely to adapter weights.
